nodes.label: Next.js Wordmark
nodes.description: 394x80 black wordmark spelling NEXT with the trailing registered-mark/JS lockup as outlined glyph paths. Vendor framework branding, fill hardcoded #000 so it only reads on light surfaces.

nodes.label: create-next-app Default Asset Set
nodes.rationale: These five SVGs are the untouched create-next-app scaffold payload (file/globe/window UI glyphs + next/vercel vendor marks), shipped by the generator rather than authored for Phosmith. They live in the clerk-nextjs/ sub-app, are disjoint from the Phosmith brand system in public/ and src/app/, and carry vendor-fixed colors (#000 / #fff) that no product theme token controls.
